passwordReset.requestSubtitle: Enter the address on your account and the panel will send a link to it.
passwordReset.requestSent: If that address belongs to an account, a reset link is on its way to it. The link is good for one hour and can be used once.
passwordReset.resetSubtitle: The link you followed lets you set a password once.
passwordReset.resetDone: Your password has been changed, and every other signed-in device has been signed out. Sign in with the new password.
